1. a slender man with a neat narrow moustache and short parted hair, no beard;
2. a bald man with a full short beard and a heavy brow;
3. a broad man with a long sweeping moustache and thick swept-back hair, no beard;
4. a man with dark wavy hair and a full pointed beard;
5. an older man with round spectacles, a trimmed grey beard and a high forehead.
Below the row, one monumental marble seat from Image 4 stands empty at a three-quarter angle, showing how these men will be seated later.

Constraints: five clearly different men, each recognizable by the features listed above at a glance; all five carved in the same white marble and the same sculptural language, so they read as one bench and not as five styles; every bust rests on its base and nothing floats; classical drapery over the shoulders instead of modern clothing; anatomically correct features; preserve the reference style; highest final quality; maximum resolution
